mechanism_narrative: A rebound in WORKPLACES mobility from its recent trough should raise weekday foot traffic to nearby retail within four weeks, so RETAIL_REC will move up if workplace trips keep recovering after the sharp dip in t-1w.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell to -27.9 in t-1w then rebounded to -11.0 in t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays near or below its t-0w level yet RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next 28 days than over the last 28 days, the mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated while WORKPLACES stays weak, people are staying home more often and substituting away from in-person shopping, which should push RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above 5 and WORKPLACES remains below -10 for at least 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive in all four weeks while WORKPLACES was negative in all four weeks
failure_condition: If the residential-workplace gap persists but RETAIL_REC rises relative to the prior 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in TRANSIT mobility indicates more multi-purpose travel and easier access to commercial districts, which should lift retail-and-recreation visits after a one-week lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises week-on-week by more than 3 points
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -36.7 in t-1w to -33.7 in t-0w
failure_condition: If a >3-point weekly rise in TRANSIT is followed by no improvement in RETAIL_REC within one week across the next month, reject the mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PARKS after an outdoor-spending spike signals fewer leisure outings and tighter public-space usage, which should reduce retail visits over the next four weeks once the surge dissipates.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls by at least 10 points from the prior week after being positive
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped to 16.1 in t-1w then dropped to 0.9 in t-0w
failure_condition: If a post-spike PARKS drop is not followed by weaker RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days than over the previous 28 days, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM is near baseline while RESIDENTIAL stays elevated, routine needs are being met locally and discretionary shopping is not being crowded out, so RETAIL_REC should stabilize or improve over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM hovered around zero across the snapshot while RESIDENTIAL stayed positive
failure_condition: If near-zero GROCERY_PHARM and positive RESIDENTIAL coincide with lower RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days, the mechanism does not hold.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed weakening in TRANSIT combined with persistent WORKPLACES softness implies stricter movement constraints or risk avoidance, which will suppress retail footfall within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -35 while WORKPLACES remains below -15
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed around -35 to -37 and WORKPLACES was below -15 in t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES satisfy the weak-mobility condition but RETAIL_REC improves over the next two weeks, reject the hypothesis.

mechanism_narrative: An upward move in PARKS during a leisure-friendly week should spill over into nearby commercial activity, causing RETAIL_REC to rise over the following week if the park surge is not immediately reversed.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by at least 8 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -3.6 in t-2w to 16.1 in t-1w before easing to 0.9
failure_condition: If a strong PARKS increase is not followed by higher RETAIL_REC within one week, the spillover claim is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If RETAIL_REC fails to recover while WORKPLACES rebounds and TRANSIT remains depressed, the city is experiencing a non-shopping mobility rebound dominated by work trips, so retail activity will stay flat or fall over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rebounded sharply in t-0w while TRANSIT stayed around -34 to -37 and RETAIL_REC weakened in t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES recovers while TRANSIT stays weak and RETAIL_REC nonetheless rises over the next 28 days, the hypothesis fails.
